Hello! I'd be happy to help you determine your eligibility for Child Benefit. I can see you're inquiring about two children - Alex (18 years old) and Blake (2 years old).

To properly assess your eligibility, I need to understand your right-to-reside status, as you've recently moved to the UK. This is crucial for determining eligibility. Could you please tell me more about your immigration or residency status? For example:

- Do you have settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme?
- Do you have pre-settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme?
- Are you a British citizen?
- Are you a Crown servant?
- Do you have indefinite leave to remain?
- Are you from an EEA or Swiss national background, or a family member of one?
- Do you have any other type of visa or immigration status?

This information will help me determine whether you have the right to reside in the UK for Child Benefit purposes.
